steps.title: Define N-Calc Project Identity
steps.description: Establish the package name com.ncalc.app and set up app metadata for N-Calc.

steps.title: Clean Android Manifest File
steps.description: Remove deprecated package attributes and setup MainActivity as the primary launcher with proper intent filters.

steps.title: Configure App Build Settings
steps.description: Set compiler and JVM settings to Java 1.8 compatibility inside Gradle configurations.

steps.title: Develop Sound Waveforms Dynamically
steps.description: Define sound-synthesis functions using PCM arrays to generate high-quality sound effects like beeps, clicks, and lasers.

steps.title: Build Sound Management Layer
steps.description: Use single-threaded worker executor to serialize AudioTrack actions and prevent main thread freezes.

steps.title: Design Keypad Layout in XML
steps.description: Create a fully styled flat numeric and operator layout using nested high-performance containers.

steps.title: Write Recursive Descent Parser
steps.description: Program an efficient mathematics evaluation engine supporting order of operations and grouped parentheses.

steps.title: Integrate Live Results Logic
steps.description: Track keypad actions and trigger real-time evaluation preview while user types.

steps.title: Add Sound Selection Panel
steps.description: Provide clickable menu icons allowing instant toggling between Mute, Click, Beep, and Laser profiles.

steps.title: Building N-Calc
steps.description: Assemble and build the debug APK using standard AGP environment.
